Title: Don't Use AI to Write
Article title: Don't use AI to write | Paul Bakker
Description: Writing requires thinking, don

Article text:
Don't use AI to write | Paul Bakker Skip to content PB Paul Bakker Articles
Writing requires thinking, don't let an AI do the thinking for you.
Tools like Claude, Codex/ChatGPT and Gemini are great.
I use them all day (both at work and personally) for coding, research, digging through data, collecting information etc.
But what I don’t use them for is writing, and I strongly suggest you do the same.
Writing forces you to deeply think about the problem you’re solving, and what you’re trying to communicate to your readers.
This is why writing is hard, but also why writing is such a useful tool to help you think.
If you generate a document based on some bullet points, or whatever the source is, you’re skipping the thinking step.
